openFindings.issue: prepare()'s catch-all maps every bootstrap failure (config drift deny, identity mismatch throw, unsupported model) to reason 'resources_unavailable', which misdirects user diagnostics even though the explicit-mismatch branch inside the try correctly uses 'config_changed'. Behavior is fail-closed; only the reported reason is wrong.
openFindings.minimalFix: In the catch, inspect the error (e.g. AssistantAnalysisProviderUnavailableError vs resource errors) and set reason='config_changed' for identity/configuration failures, keeping 'resources_unavailable' only for resource-layer failures.

openFindings.issue: current()'s single catch conflates store read failures and readCurrentModel() transport errors with genuine identity drift, always reporting 'config_changed'. Safe direction (provider is cleared, never resurrected), but the reason can mislead.
openFindings.minimalFix: Catch readCurrentModel()/comparison failures separately from store errors, or add a distinct reason value for store/runtime errors.

openFindings.issue: A process crash between the atomic link() (line 86) and unlink() (line 87) leaves an orphaned '.manifest-<uuid>.tmp' inside the leaf. Cruft is harmless (verify/manifest comparison ignore leaf-root extras; link() still refuses to replace an existing manifest), but stale temps are never swept.
openFindings.minimalFix: On prepare, best-effort remove leaf entries matching /^\.manifest-.*\.tmp$/ owned by this uid before or after publishManifest.
